revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 4.3% and FY23-25 revenue roughly flat to up; modest cyclical recovery and pricing/services growth fading toward GDP-plus by FY2030.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: between FY2025 16.5% (11151/67589) and FY2023-24 average ~19.8%; partial margin recovery, conservative to peak, flat across the projection.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate of 21%; Damodaran US Machinery effective rate is 13.4% but taken as non-sustainable for conservative base.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 4.2% (2821/67589) vs FY23 2.4%, FY24 3.1%; elevated investment cycle normalizing to 4.0%, above D&A.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.01 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = Ke 9.4%; beta = Damodaran Machinery cash-corrected unlevered 0.894 relevered at industry D/E 0.147 and 21% tax; Kd after-tax 3.97% (Damodaran Machinery); weights 87.2% equity/12.8% debt (Damodaran industry). Result ~8.7%. Company market D/E not computed as no share price available.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US GDP-type growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements CAT derived net_debt = total debt 43,330 (LT 30,696 + due in 12m 7,120 + short-term borrowings 5,514) - cash 9,980; accession 0000018230-26-000008. Note: includes Financial Products debt; no short-term investments reported.
